description: Protein-level detection of AT5G03810 and its clade across 30 Arabidopsis tissues
code:
import requests, pandas as pd, numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
h={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'}
txt=requests.get("https://www.ebi.ac.uk/gxa/experiments-content/E-PROT-135/resources/ExperimentDownloadSupplier.Proteomics/tsv",
                 headers=h,timeout=200).text
lines=[l for l in txt.split("\n") if l and not l.startswith("#")]
hdr=lines[0].split("\t")
tis=[c.replace("continuous light regimen, ","").replace("long day length regimen (16h/8h), ","") for c in hdr[2:]]
genes={"AT5G03810":"At5g03810 (target)","AT5G03820":"At5g03820","AT5G22810":"At5g22810","AT3G53100":"At3g53100",
       "AT3G16370":"APG","AT5G40990":"GLIP1","AT1G75910":"EXL4","AT3G14210":"ESM1"}
dat={}
for l in lines[1:]:
    p=l.split("\t")
    if p[0].upper() in genes:
        dat[genes[p[0].upper()]]=[np.nan if (len(p)<=i+2 or p[i+2].strip()=="") else float(p[i+2]) for i in range(len(tis))]
P=pd.DataFrame(dat,index=tis)
print("total proteome-atlas tissues:",len(tis))
print("\ndetected in n tissues (of %d):"%len(tis))
print(P.notna().sum().to_string())
print("\ntop 6 tissues per protein (iBAQ-like abundance):")
for c in P.columns:
    s=P[c].dropna().sort_values(ascending=False)
    if len(s)==0: print(" %-20s NOT DETECTED in any tissue"%c); continue
    print(" %-20s"%c, "; ".join("%s=%.0f"%(i,v) for i,v in s.head(6).items()))
P.to_csv("E-PROT-135_APGclade_protein_matrix.csv")

sub=P[["At5g03810 (target)","At5g03820","At3g53100","APG","EXL4"]]
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(10,8))
L=np.log10(sub.fillna(0)+1)
im=ax.imshow(L.values,aspect='auto',cmap="magma")
ax.set_yticks(range(len(tis))); ax.set_yticklabels(tis,fontsize=7)
ax.set_xticks(range(sub.shape[1])); ax.set_xticklabels(sub.columns,rotation=30,ha='right',fontsize=8)
plt.colorbar(im,label="log10(protein abundance + 1)")
ax.set_title("Arabidopsis proteomic tissue atlas (E-PROT-135):\nAt5g03810 protein detection vs APG-clade relatives",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
